Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioners are seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.T. Case No.553 of 2023 pending on the file of learned Addl. District & Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge (POSCO), Balasore arising out of Basta P.S. Case No.230 of 2023 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 363/
376(2)(f)(n)/ 109/ 34 of IPC read with Section 6/7 of POCSO Act.
3.

entities.text: Addl. District & Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge (POSCO), Balasore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Perused the essence of 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim as recorded in the Case Diary.
4. This Court is constrained to refer to the same, since learned counsel for the State was not provided with the complete 164 Cr.P.C. statement in spite of the intimation in this regard.

5. On going through the recitals of the essence of the statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.,
this Court is not inclined to entertain the ABLAPL in respect of Petitioner Nos.2 & 3.

However, in the event Petitioner Nos.2 & 3 (Bapi @ Kamalakanta Mahalik & Kalia @ Kalicharan Mahalik Kartik Chandra Mahalik vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Parties on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/134343757/
1 respectively) surrender before the learned Court in seisin in the aforesaid case and move an application for their release on bail, the same shall be considered on its own merit.

entities.text: Kalia @ Kalicharan Mahalik Kartik Chandra Mahalik vs State Of Odisha
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. So far as Petitioner Nos.1, 4 & 5 are concerned, taking into account the nature of allegations qua the said Petitioner Nos.1, 4 & 5, this Court directs that on surrendering within three weeks hence and moving for bail, Petitioner Nos.1, 4 & 5 (Kartik Chandra Mahalik, Purna Chandra Jena & Suresh Jena respectively) shall be released on bail by the learned Court in seisin on such terms as deemed just and proper.
7. It is needless to state that the Petitioner Nos.1, 4 & 5 shall cooperate with the ongoing investigation.
8. Accordingly, the ABLAPL stands disposed of.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge Ayesha Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack Kartik Chandra Mahalik vs State Of Odisha ....
